captions.caption: A cinematic electronic soundtrack which announces the epic journey the protagonist will undertake in a post-apocalyptic world.
A symphonic orchestra intro, followed by piano and electronic sounds, builds into a modern calm electronic song with female vocals and some ethnic atmosphere.
